missionPremise: Every Tier-1 bake writes baseFacts.cadRoll ALL-NULL by design (nodeFacetBakeTier1Cli.ts:507-514, verified at source); population is deferred to a separate CLI, nodeFacetPatchCadRollFromCadPropertyCli.ts, which had NEVER been run for any of the six Central-TX counties before this session. facetScore (the monotonic guard) does not count cadRoll as a coverage dimension, so a future re-bake without the patch folded in silently re-nulls it even at an equal-or-better score. The onboarding runbook (factory_onboarding_runbook.md Step Z7, lines 80-92, verified at source) documents only the bake half.

correctionsToDispatch.sourceCheck: nodeFacetPatchCadRollFromCadPropertyCli.ts:108-118 (pre-fix) is a plain UPDATE ... FROM unnest(...) WHERE adapter_key=$4 AND place_key=v.place_key — no ON CONFLICT clause. newFindingNotInDispatch.reconciliationOpenQuestion: joinNormalize.ts documents Hays owner-match rate two ways in the same file: ~0.013% (10/78k, line 29) and ~1.1% (line 69) — internally inconsistent with each other, and both far below my street-address-based 54.8%-72.2% true-match reading (varies by sample method). Not reconciled; recorded as an open question per doc-repo-26's instruction rather than picking one number. Possible explanations neither confirmed nor ruled out: owner-name matching under-counts real matches (trusts/LLCs/formatting drift) vs. situs-address matching over-counts (shared/generic addresses) vs. the underlying data changed since the owner-match figure was measured.

rootCauseInvestigation.status: in progress, handed back to doc-repo-26/CTX-A/CTX-D — not concluded
rootCauseInvestigation.supersededHypothesis: Initial framing ('two disjoint cad_property ingests under different declared tax_years, DECLARED_CAD_VINTAGES points at the wrong one') is TRUE as a description of cad_property's own structure (verified: tax_year=2025 stratmap-roll rows are 100% R-prefixed, tax_year=2026 cad-export rows are 100% numeric) but was WRONGLY presented as the mechanism behind place_layer_snapshots's R-vs-numeric node split. Retracted after row-level testing.
rootCauseInvestigation.correctedFinding: Both an R-prefixed and a numeric-id sample node were written by the CONFORMANT bake (nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli.ts / lib/nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts, parcelSource='conformant-v1-cad-parcel-roll'), which reads cad-parcel-roll ATOMS from hauska_mcp (a different database, CTX-A's ingest domain) and cross-walks to txgio_parcel geometry via situs-address, not propId. Colocation test: 500-row random sample of R-prefixed nodes (excluding a 0.00000 coordinate sentinel), checked for a numeric-id node sharing the exact same rounded lat/lng (5-decimal, ~1m) — 448/500 (89.6%) colocated. Conclusion: the R-prefixed and numeric-id populations are mostly the SAME physical parcels represented under two valid-but-different identity conventions (TxGIO/CAD's public 'R-account' display id vs CAD's separate internal numeric account number — both real, per joinNormalize.ts's own documented duality), not two disjoint halves of the county. 602,050 total Tier-1 nodes for Williamson is very likely inflated by this duplication, not the true unique parcel count.
rootCauseInvestigation.notVerified: Whether every numeric node has an R-twin (only checked R-to-numeric direction). Which node-id format the live SERVING path (PMTiles click-to-resolve / Property Explorer) actually queries by today — this is the decisive remaining question for CTX-A's write and I could not answer it: PMTiles appears to be a GCS-hosted file artifact, not a queryable Postgres table, and tracing it further goes into serving infrastructure outside this lane's scope and outside this database.
rootCauseInvestigation.urgentCoordination: doc-repo-26 pulled this into an active, time-sensitive question ahead of the rest of the investigation: whether CTX-A's imminent Williamson zoning re-stamp (7 city layers) would reach nodes actually served, given current txgio_parcel is 100% R-prefixed with zero numeric rows while the richest existing zoning data (115,832 of 228,639 zoned nodes) is numeric-id with real city-stamp provenance and R-prefixed nodes have a 0-for-0 track record with that stamping pipeline. Reported the data directly to doc-repo-26 and cente-c1/CTX-A; corrected the framing once the colocation finding landed; did not reach a final verdict on CTX-A's write safety — that decision needs the serving-path answer and belongs to CTX-A/doc-repo-26, not CTX-C.
